proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost.triggered_on_event
proposed_widenings.justification: Indomitable fires reactively when a specific game event occurs (failing a saving throw). ClassFeatureActivationCost only has 'free' and 'bonus_action'. Neither expresses event-triggered activation. Using 'free' would drop the trigger constraint and misrepresent the mechanic.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect.modify_roll_reroll_with_bonus
proposed_widenings.justification: Indomitable's core effect is to reroll a failed saving throw and add a class-level-scaled flat bonus to the result. The v4 atoms 'modify_roll_reroll' and 'modify_roll_numeric' both exist in the taxonomy but ClassFeatureEffect only contains GrantExtraActionEffect and HealHpEffect. A new variant expressing (reroll + numeric modifier on a named roll) is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level. You must use the new roll

notes: Resource machinery fits cleanly: UseCountCap as ThresholdTiers<number> (axis=class, base=1, tiers L13→2, L17→3) and RestResetCadence.long_rest are both in the type system. The two blockers are surface-layer gaps, not atom gaps: (1) ClassFeatureActivationCost has no triggered/reactive variant, and (2) ClassFeatureEffect has no roll-modification variant. All required v4 atoms exist: modify_roll_reroll, modify_roll_numeric, scale_numeric_bonus, use_count, rest_window. No dhall/json authored — encoding would require lying about either the trigger condition or the effect type.
